title: Must and need
summary: Say what someone must, should or mustn't do with `-mAlY`, which has no personal ending, so the subject is always said (*Men gitmeli*, *gitmeli däl*, *gitmelimi?*), what someone needs with *gerek* (*Maňa suw gerek*), and what you had to or will have to do with *bolmak* (*gitmeli boldum*, *gitmeli bolarys*), at the doctor's and in front of the signs.
canDo: Say what you and others must, should or mustn't do, saying who each time
Say what you need, and refuse politely with Gerek däl
Say what you had to do, and what you will have to do
Tell a doctor what hurts, and understand rules and signs
